session_note: Cloud-agent session on branch cursor/semaev-2015-audit-program-5b8b, 2026-09-13, on user instruction to add a Nagao pursuit to the Semaev 2015 program. The paper was fetched because KN-LIT-456 has been this program's entry for it since 2026-07-24 and carries no content at all -- 'No abstract was extractable from the first two pages of the local PDF; contribution recorded from the title only' -- while the paper turns out to be a direct commentary on inputs/SEMAEV-2015-310/, the frozen source GOAL-SEMBIN-5078bc is auditing. Under core rule 9 a title-only entry supports nothing. Reading it converts a pointer into a citable source.

attempts.purpose: Freeze the full text of Nagao's disjoint-factor-base variant of Semaev's chained-S_3 algorithm: Definitions 5-6 (true versus fake first fall degree), Lemmas 3-4 and 6, Propositions 2-6, Section 7's disjoint factor base, and Theorem 1's O(n^{8w+1}) polynomial-time claim
attempts.reason: Vendored under the paper's CC BY licence. Two fetches were made seconds apart and produced identical sha256 values, so the copy in the repository is the copy that was read.
attempts.revision_id: single version; ePrint history shows only '2015-10-12: received'

attempts.purpose: Establish the revision count, the licence, the declared category, and the author's own keywords
attempts.method: curl -sS -D headers-landing.txt -o landing.html --max-time 90, then tag-stripped to text in-session
attempts.not_vendored_reason: The landing page is IACR site chrome around metadata that is transcribed into source_record.yaml verbatim. Vendoring the HTML would freeze a navigation menu, not a source. The facts taken from it are the four below and nothing else.

derived_artifacts.extractor_note: Identical extractor and parameters to inputs/SEMAEV-2015-310/, deliberately: the two papers are read side by side and a textual difference between them should mean a difference between the papers, not between two extractors.
known_extraction_artifacts: fi/ff/fl ligatures preserved as the PDF encodes them
'⁄=' for the non-equality sign in Definitions 5 and 6
summation limits and superscripts flattened onto the baseline, so displayed formulas break across lines -- notably Theorem 1's exponents and Section 7's cost expression

what_this_provenance_does_not_assert: That Nagao's Theorem 1 is correct, that its first fall degree assumption holds at the parameters it is applied to, or that Proposition 5 (stated with its proof omitted) is true. This records only that the bytes in this directory are the bytes served by eprint.iacr.org at the recorded time, and that the text file is a mechanical extraction of them.
